title: Letters and Harbor
premise: Cyrus Marchetti's failing café is saved when a mysterious investor buys the debt — but the investor turns out to be Elena Vasquez, the woman he loved and abandoned eleven years ago, now a powerful wine magnate who never received his letter explaining why he left. As Cyrus works to win back her trust while fighting his own corrupt business partner, who is sabotaging both the café and her vineyard, they uncover that the lost letter was intercepted by someone who profited from their separation. At the vineyard's first harvest, Cyrus must choose between a lucrative career offer in Paris and staying to build something honest with Elena, choosing love and integrity over ambition as the harvest comes in.
about_author: Tamsin Winterbourne is a former pastry chef turned novelist who writes love stories set in coastal towns where food, memory, and second chances intertwine. She lives above her own small café with her partner and an opinionated cat named Brioche.

chapters.title: Three Missed Payments
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. The chapter opens in Salt & Sugar café at dawn, Cyrus kneading dough he can barely afford flour for, counting days until foreclosure. His partner Dominic offers a lifeline with strings attached. Emotional beat: quiet desperation masked by competence.

chapters.title: The Letter, Postmarked Eleven Years Ago
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. A water-damaged envelope surfaces behind a renovated wall — his own handwriting, addressed to Elena Vasquez, returned unopened. He reads what he wrote at twenty-four and can't finish it. Emotional beat: grief resurfacing like a tide.

chapters.title: The Investor
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena arrives at the café unannounced, having bought the debt through her holding company. She is composed, expensive, unreadable. Cyrus realizes she knows about the letter. Emotional beat: recognition sharpened into wariness.

chapters.title: Terms of Surrender
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena sets conditions: she'll save the café if Cyrus helps her catalog her late father's vineyard archives before first harvest. Neither names what they're really negotiating. Emotional beat: pride wrestling with longing.

chapters.title: What the Cellar Keeps
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. In the dusty vineyard cellar, they sort letters and ledgers, circling each other with old jokes that still land. Cyrus learns her father died believing Cyrus betrayed them. Emotional beat: tenderness under armor.

chapters.title: Dominic's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Dominic pushes Cyrus to sign over majority stake in exchange for instant solvency, hinting he knows things about Elena's finances. Cyrus notices discrepancies in the café's books. Emotional beat: creeping suspicion.

chapters.title: Harvest Eve Dinner
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The vineyard crew's traditional pre-harvest dinner; Elena's found family of workers folds Cyrus in despite themselves. Someone mentions a letter Elena's father burned years ago. Emotional beat: belonging offered cautiously.

chapters.title: The Interception
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena finds evidence her father's foreman — now her operations manager, Marcus — handled all correspondence during the estrangement years. She confronts nothing yet, but begins pulling threads. Emotional beat: dread dressed as diligence.

chapters.title: Flour on Her Hands
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Elena shows up at 4 a.m. to learn bread-making, claiming insomnia. They work side by side, and for one hour the past dissolves. She almost tells him about Marcus; she doesn't. Emotional beat: intimacy rekindled, then flinched from.

chapters.title: Paris Calling
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. An old mentor offers Cyrus a head pastry position in Paris — the career that would fix everything financially. Dominic encourages him loudly. Cyrus hides the offer from Elena. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a familiar face.

chapters.title: Ledgers and Lies
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena discovers Marcus has been skimming vineyard profits for years and intercepting mail, including Cyrus's letter — paid, she suspects, by someone else. The trail points toward Dominic. Emotional beat: cold clarity hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Storm Over the Vines
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. A hailstorm threatens the young crop days before harvest; the whole crew fights through the night to save it. Cyrus and Elena work soaked and laughing, old love undeniable. Emotional beat: joy earned through shared labor.

chapters.title: The Burned Letter
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. In her father's safe, Elena finds a partially burned draft revealing her father knew about the interception and confronted Marcus weeks before his death. The accident that killed him may not have been an accident. Emotional beat: grief recontextualized as betrayal.

chapters.title: Confession at Low Tide
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Cyrus finally tells Elena why he left eleven years ago — her father gave him money to disappear, believing him unworthy, and Cyrus took it out of shame. Elena reels. Emotional beat: truth as both wound and release.

chapters.title: Marcus Makes His Move
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Marcus, sensing exposure, presents Elena with falsified documents implicating Cyrus in the skimming, timed with Dominic's pressure on the café. Cyrus is locked out of the vineyard. Emotional beat: the trap closing.

chapters.title: Everything He Built
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. With the café seized and reputation smeared, Cyrus nearly signs the Paris contract. Instead he spends the night reconstructing the financial trail with old receipts and memory. Emotional beat: rock bottom becoming bedrock.

chapters.title: The Crew Decides
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena brings the evidence to her workers — her found family — instead of lawyers first. The harvest crew vouches for Cyrus, and Rosa, the eldest, reveals she saw Marcus near the road the night of the father's accident. Emotional beat: loyalty as testimony.

chapters.title: Confrontation in the Barrel Room
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Climax. Cyrus and Elena corner Marcus and Dominic together among the barrels; Dominic confesses he paid Marcus to intercept the letter years ago to keep Cyrus desperate and controllable. Police arrive; the harvest bell rings. Emotional beat: justice arriving with the dawn.

chapters.title: First Harvest
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. The whole community harvests together, Cyrus's hands among theirs, the Paris offer declined by phone before sunrise. Elena watches him choose without being asked. Emotional beat: abundance after scarcity.

chapters.title: What He Wrote Next
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Cyrus writes a new letter and hands it to her unsealed. It contains no explanations, only intentions. She reads it standing in the crush pad, then kisses him amid the bins of fruit. Emotional beat: love stated plainly at last.

chapters.title: Salt & Sugar, Reopened
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. The café reopens under new honest ownership — a cooperative between Cyrus, Elena, and the crew. The old letter is framed beside the counter, a scar kept visible. Emotional beat: home rebuilt on truth.

chapters.title: Letters and Harbor
chapters.summary: Alternating POV, closing. One year later: first bottling day, the café thriving, Elena and Cyrus writing annual letters to each other they deliver by hand. The harbor holds the boats; the letters hold the years. Emotional beat: peace chosen daily, not once.
